heading: Annual report
lead: The corporation shall make an annual report to Congress, to be filed with the Librarian of Congress.

Termination of Reporting RequirementsFor termination, effective May 15, 2000, of reporting provisions in this section, see section 3003 of Pub. L. 104–66, set out as a note under section 1113 of Title 31, Money and Finance, and page 196 of House Document No. 103–7.
